sample_unit: Million Veteran Program participants with opioid exposure
models_evaluated: ensemble machine learning model using 15 candidate genetic variants

links.outcome: Predictive value of 15 genetic variants from an FDA-approved OUD risk algorithm
links.effect: The 15 variants explained 0.40% of OUD risk variation versus 3.27% for age and sex alone; the ensemble ML model correctly classified 52.83% (95% CI, 52.07%-53.59%) of individuals in the independent testing sample.
links.quote: Results of this study suggest that the candidate genetic variants included in the approved algorithm do not meet reasonable standards of efficacy in identifying OUD risk.

links.outcome: Independent verification of the clinical utility of variants in a regulator-approved algorithm
links.effect: Independent testing found the variants explained 0.40% of OUD variation (age and sex 3.27%) and classified 52.83% correctly; clinical use would cause high false-positive and false-negative rates.
links.quote: However, the clinical utility of the candidate genetic variants included in the algorithm has not been independently demonstrated.

screen.reason: Independent external validation of an FDA-cleared predictive algorithm's candidate genetic variants using a large retrospective EHR/genomic dataset.
